concept: Redshift: columnar DWH for petabyte-scale analytics
tests: Choosing a service for complex analytical SQL queries over petabytes of structured data.
expected: Amazon Redshift — a columnar MPP data warehouse for OLAP. Triggers: "complex analytical SQL", "petabytes", "aggregated from many sources", "scan large amounts of data".
why_not: RDS PostgreSQL — OLTP, not for petabyte analytics; DynamoDB — key-value; ElastiCache — in-memory cache.
